candidates.name: Second-order action-path areas
candidates.novelty_delta: Noncommutative action ordering at candidate pair; counts and final action recencies insufficient.
candidates.nonalias_witness: VVCCVPC vs VCVCVPC at seconds 1..7: same counts/latest action times, A_VC=5 vs 3.
candidates.source_mechanism: Truncated log-signature and Lie brackets in Log-NCDE neural time-series models.
candidates.adaptation: Three raw degree-two antisymmetric coordinates in fixed-C boosting; no neural encoder.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Length/repetition proxy already recoverable from counts/recencies; no useful incremental order signal.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Seven-event literal witness, simultaneous bucket invariance, future suffix invariance; no data/fit needed.
candidates.matched_baseline: B vs B+three areas; prespecified order-shuffled diagnostic preserving counts/final action times.
candidates.temporal: Global <t, exact 7d, simultaneous buckets, no fitted state; expiry requires ordered aggregate structure.
candidates.future_cap: 100Q/220C each, 1M matched records, source30 CPUmin/4GB RSS; two fits90 CPUmin separately reserved.

candidates.name: Item audience contribution shape

candidates.nonalias_witness: Viewer multiplicities (5,1) vs (3,3): N6/D2 equal; cap2=3 vs4, HHI26/36 vs18/36.
candidates.source_mechanism: Per-device/window contribution bounding then cross-device aggregation in Mayfly federated analytics.
candidates.adaptation: cap2, audience concentration and maximum contribution share as three fixed-C diagnostics; no DP guarantee.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Loyal audience concentration is valid signal or already approximated by total/distinct interactions.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Two literal multiplicity histograms and exact multiplicity expiry.
candidates.matched_baseline: B vs B+exact closure on same Q/C/Y and training prefix; prespecified low-distinct/repeat slices.

candidates.name: Purchase-reset observed action episode
candidates.novelty_delta: Candidate-specific purchase-defined boundary, retaining separate same-second ambiguity instead of fixed-window totals.
candidates.nonalias_witness: P4/C7/V8 final times and cart count3 equal; carts (1,2,7) vs (1,6,7) yield post-purchase cart counts1 vs2.
candidates.source_mechanism: POWL partial-order process discovery with explicit loops; accessed v1 is a non-peer-reviewed preprint.
candidates.adaptation: Three observed episode summaries after last purchase and in purchase peer bucket; paper does not propose this shopping reset.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Observed purchase does not reset intent; partial histories and logging delay make segmentation harmful.

candidates.physical_columns: 3 cores conditional on exact reuse of existing purchase-availability mask.

candidates.name: Support-context feature-arm router transfer
candidates.novelty_delta: Query-conditional selection among fixed trained feature arms; leave one support context out to test transfer beyond one global winner.
candidates.source_mechanism: AATention transfers checker vectors; per-generator target-domain KNN remains trained, with transfer failures in a cooperative domain.
candidates.adaptation: KNN routing whole-query model choice using three past-only query support descriptors and mature paired development rewards; no pretrained attention weights.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Sparse positives make apparent arm specialization noise; global winner generalizes better.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: If all arms have equal query rankings, achievable routing gain is algebraically zero; approved development predictions required later.
candidates.matched_baseline: Transferred router vs best global arm, matched random routing and simple support-rule router on newly reserved period.
candidates.physical_columns: 0 new ranker columns; three existing query-support descriptors feed router.
candidates.temporal: Arm models available before evaluation, router rewards mature before fit, user-grouped forward fitting, heldout still closed.
candidates.future_cap: At most5 arms, <=2000 labelled query summaries, k15, numeric storage<=10MB, one router fit, total30 CPUmin/4GB RSS; scoring costs charged.
